example_1_en: Every subassembly should have electrical continuity to the next higher assembly.
example_1_zh: 每個次組件都應與上一層組件具有電氣連續性。
example_2_en: The avionics panel is treated as a subassembly of the ring.
example_2_zh: 航電板可視為航電環的一個次組件。

example_1_en: The faying surface must be cleaned before assembly.
example_1_zh: 接合面在組裝前必須清潔。
example_2_en: Paint on the faying surface will degrade the electrical connection.
example_2_zh: 接合面上的油漆會降低電氣連接品質。

example_1_en: Both mating surfaces must be free of nonconductive films.
example_1_zh: 兩個配合面都必須沒有非導電薄膜。
example_2_en: The connector flange and panel mating surface require preparation.
example_2_zh: 接頭法蘭與面板配合面需要進行表面準備。

example_1_en: Metal-to-metal contact is preferred for RF performance.
example_1_zh: 金屬對金屬接觸對 RF 性能較佳。
example_2_en: A gasket may be needed when metal-to-metal contact is not reliable.
example_2_zh: 當金屬對金屬接觸不可靠時，可能需要墊片。

example_1_en: A threaded fastener should not be the only current path.
example_1_zh: 螺紋緊固件不應成為唯一的電流路徑。
example_2_en: The threaded fastener mainly provides mechanical preload.
example_2_zh: 螺紋緊固件主要提供機械預緊力。

example_1_en: Rivets can provide good contact when installed correctly.
example_1_zh: 鉚釘若正確安裝，可提供良好接觸。
example_2_en: At least three rivets are often recommended for one junction.
example_2_zh: 一個接合點通常建議至少使用三個鉚釘。

example_1_en: Proper preload keeps the joint stable under vibration.
example_1_zh: 適當的預緊力可讓接點在振動下保持穩定。
example_2_en: Loss of preload may increase contact resistance.
example_2_zh: 預緊力喪失可能增加接觸電阻。

example_1_en: A jumper may be used when direct contact is impractical.
example_1_zh: 當直接接觸不可行時，可使用跳接線。
example_2_en: The jumper should be short, wide, and easy to inspect.
example_2_zh: 跳接線應該短、寬且容易檢查。

example_1_en: A flat strap usually has lower inductance than a round wire.
example_1_zh: 扁平帶材通常比圓線有較低電感。
example_2_en: Keep the strap as short as possible.
example_2_zh: 盡可能縮短帶材長度。

example_1_en: Larger surface area improves current carrying capability.
example_1_zh: 較大的表面積可改善載流能力。
example_2_en: The design should maximize surface area at RF joints.
example_2_zh: 設計應最大化 RF 接點的接觸面積。

example_1_en: Direct bonding is metal-to-metal contact between joined members.
example_1_zh: 直接接合是相接構件之間的金屬對金屬接觸。
example_2_en: Direct bonding is preferred when the mating surfaces are accessible.
example_2_zh: 當配合面可接近時，直接接合是優先方法。

example_1_en: Indirect bonding is a connection made with a conductive jumper or strap.
example_1_zh: 間接接合是利用導電跨接線或接合帶形成的連接。
example_2_en: Indirect bonding is used when direct metal contact is impractical.
example_2_zh: 當直接金屬接觸不可行時會使用間接接合。

example_1_en: A permanent joint is formed when mating surfaces become one piece of metal.
example_1_zh: 永久接頭是在配合面結合成一體金屬時形成。
example_2_en: A welded or brazed joint is considered a permanent joint.
example_2_zh: 焊接或硬銲接頭被視為永久接頭。

example_1_en: A semi-permanent joint is held together by removable fasteners.
example_1_zh: 半永久接頭是以可拆式緊固件固定。
example_2_en: A bolted or riveted assembly is considered a semi-permanent joint.
example_2_zh: 螺栓或鉚接組件被視為半永久接頭。

example_1_en: Contact pressure is necessary to maintain a stable conductive interface.
example_1_zh: 接觸壓力對維持穩定導電介面是必要的。
example_2_en: Adequate contact pressure is maintained by fasteners on the faying surfaces.
example_2_zh: 配合面上的緊固件會維持足夠的接觸壓力。

example_1_en: Multiple fasteners are useful on large mating flanges.
example_1_zh: 多個緊固件適用於大型配合凸緣。
example_2_en: The use of multiple fasteners is analyzed as part of the bond path.
example_2_zh: 多個緊固件的使用會作為接合路徑的一部分進行分析。

example_1_en: Bond strap installation is controlled to prevent damage and excess inductance.
example_1_zh: 接合帶安裝會受到控制，以避免損傷與過大電感。
example_2_en: Proper bond strap installation is important under vibration and motion.
example_2_zh: 正確的接合帶安裝對振動與移動環境很重要。

example_1_en: Cross-sectional area is selected for the current carried by a conductor.
example_1_zh: 截面積會依導體承載的電流選定。
example_2_en: Adequate cross-sectional area is necessary for lightning bonding straps.
example_2_zh: 雷擊接合帶需要足夠的截面積。

example_1_en: A brazed joint is a permanent metallic connection formed with filler metal.
example_1_zh: 硬銲接頭是利用填料金屬形成的永久金屬連接。
example_2_en: A properly brazed joint is considered inherently bonded.
example_2_zh: 正確製作的硬銲接頭被視為本質上已接合。

example_1_en: Strain relief is used to prevent mechanical loads from damaging a bond strap.
example_1_zh: 應變消除用於避免機械負載損傷接合帶。
example_2_en: Adequate strain relief is important when a strap moves during service.
example_2_zh: 接合帶在使用中會移動時，足夠的應變消除很重要。
